clusters.theme: LiteBIRD n_T rescue paths: LSST kappa-kappa A_lens prior + extended 6-7yr LB + >50% delensing to push W4-37 sigma(n_T) below 0.04 PASS threshold
clusters.representative_title: LiteBIRD n_T rescue paths via LSST A_lens prior + extended mission + delensing
clusters.merge_rationale: Both items compute the same Fisher-forecast quantity: whether external A_lens prior from LSST kappa-kappa (plus 6-7yr LB extension and >50% delensing) tightens the joint sigma(n_T) from W4-37 below the 0.04 PASS threshold. Inputs are identical (W4-37 Fisher construction, LSST kappa-kappa forecast, LB extended mission specs). Item 22 is the mack-origin version; item 120 is the transit-origin version enumerating the same three rescue paths.

clusters.theme: f_B = c_S_canon coincidence vs closed-form identity test
clusters.merge_rationale: Verbatim duplicate gates. Both items test whether W5-64 observation f_B_joint = 0.485 = c_S_canon is a closed-form identity or a 6-sig-fig coincidence via decomposition of the f_B inversion chain. Identical inputs (W5-64 data, S83 G46 r_CMB derivation, sound-speed definitions at fold). Item 47 is tesla-origin (no gate ID assigned); item 48 is mack-origin with explicit CSCANON-IDENTITY gate ID. Conservative merge: same test, same inputs, same hypothesis.

clusters.theme: Two-speed acoustic metric (c_T/c_S = 2.062) re-adjudication for n_T(CMB) under W4-48: test whether c_T=c_S=1 was a CHOICE or CONSEQUENCE, compute n_T at L_max>=8, project detector reach
clusters.representative_title: n_T(CMB) two-speed acoustic metric re-adjudication under W4-48 with L_max>=8 spectrum and detector projection
clusters.merge_rationale: Both items interrogate the two-speed acoustic metric (c_T/c_S != 1) implications for LiteBIRD n_T. Item 77 asks the convention question: whether S68 LITEB-R-FORECAST-68's c_T=c_S=1 assumption was a CHOICE or CONSEQUENCE of prior convention. Item 148 executes the companion computation: verify c_T/c_S = 2.062 structural preservation at L_max>=8, compute n_T(k_CMB) under the L_max=8 spectrum, and project R_realized for delensing>50% + LSST A_lens prior against 2030-2040 detector 1-sigma thresholds. Shared input chain (W4-48 flag row 4, W4-39 derivation chain, W4-37 Fisher 3-param, S68 LITEB-R-FORECAST-68 code). Conservative merge: one is the convention diagnostic, the other is the numerical projection, but they are the same W4-48 adjudication.

singletons.title: LiteBIRD n_T W4-41 permanent registry landing: write up EVOI=0 as structural
singletons.singleton_rationale: Documentation/registry task, not a computation. Writes up W4-41 EVOI=0 as structurally permanent for the 2030-2040 window and attaches it to the W4-48 rigor registry. Distinct from clusters 01/03: those actively TEST whether rescue paths (LSST prior, extended mission, delensing) or two-speed adjudication change the PASS status; this item LOCKS IN the already-computed EVOI=0 verdict as a permanent registry entry. No computation, no new gate threshold.

summary.merge_philosophy: Conservative: merged only where items computed the same observable (n_T rescue paths), tested the same identity (f_B=c_S_canon), or re-adjudicated the same two-speed metric question. Kept registry/writeup task (71) separate from active rescue-path computations (22, 120) even though both reference W4-41 EVOI=0, because the deliverable type differs (documentation vs Fisher projection).
summary.distinct_observables_preserved: n_T (via rescue paths and two-speed) vs f_B=c_S_canon identity are different physical questions and remain in separate clusters despite both being LiteBIRD-adjacent.
